summary: Apyx Medical Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a routine reconstitution of board committee membership and chairs, effective July 24, 2026. The filing details the assignment of three independent directors to the Audit, Governance and Nominating, Regulatory Compliance, and Compensation Committees, noting that Executive Chairman Stavros Vizirgianakis will not serve on any committee. No financial terms, special transaction, shareholder vote, or strategic event is disclosed. This is a standard governance disclosure with no special-situation implications. No action or risk-arb angle arises from this filing.
